# Artefact

> Artefact is a human-centered design and innovation agency specializing in AI, strategy, and responsible technology outcomes for social impact.

Artefact combines design consulting, UX research, and innovation strategy to help organizations navigate emerging technologies like generative AI. The firm partners with nonprofits, healthcare institutions, and tech companies to create culturally responsive, ethically-designed digital products and platforms.

## Key Topics

- Human-Centered Design
- Generative AI
- Responsible Design
- Social Impact
- Design Tools
- Innovation Strategy
- UX Research
- Culturally Responsive Design
- Digital Wellbeing
- The Tarot Cards of Tech
- Design Consulting

- Emerging Technologies

## Case Studies & Client Work

- [Opportunity International CoLab](https://www.artefactgroup.com/case-studies/opportunity-international-colab): Artefact partnership with Opportunity International on generative AI apps
- [PRISM: Helping Young Patients Build Resilience](https://artefactgroup.com/case-studies/prism): Seattle Children's Hospital digital wellbeing app for young patients
- [Figma: A Glimpse into GenAI Within the Teams of Tomorrow](https://www.artefactgroup.com/case-studies/figma-a-glimpse-into-genai-within-the-teams-of-tomorrow): Artefact research on generative AI impact in collaborative design teams
- [Hopelab: Promoting Youth Well-being in Digital Spaces](https://www.artefactgroup.com/case-studies/promoting-youth-well-being-in-digital-spaces): Artefact partnership with Hopelab on youth mental health in metaverse and web3
- [Traverse: A Vision for Culturally Responsive Healthcare](https://www.artefactgroup.com/case-studies/enabling-culturally-responsive-healthcare): AI-powered digital platform for culturally responsive healthcare interactions
